Once a [[Tibanna gas platform]] on the planet [[Kaer]], '''Kaer Station''' was the center of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun's]] operations in the [[Siskeen system/Legends|Siskeen system]] during the time of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. It also served as the seat of power for [[Lun Rask]], the [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].
